basic_info.description: Welcome to this charming home nestled in the heart of San Francisco. With a generous living area of 1,592 sq ft, this residence offers three comfortable bedrooms and two full bathrooms, including a convenient ground floor bedroom and a bathroom. Upstairs bathroom features a separate tub and shower, and downstairs stall shower. The kitchen is well-appointed with a gas cooktop, granite countertops, an oven range, refrigerator, and skylight, making it a delightful space for culinary endeavors.  Hardwood flooring through out the living & dinning rooms.  This property falls within the San Francisco Unified School District. All gourmet restaurants just down the block. Experience city living with this lovely home.
